faqs.q: What is the Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 skive ferrule used for?
faqs.a: The Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 is a skive crimp ferrule for wire braid hoses. The hose cover is skived back before crimping so the ferrule closes directly onto the wire reinforcement. It is sold by the piece in 11 references from DN5 – DN51 (3/16" – 2"); see the [Ferrules shelf](/c/ferrules) for the other series.

faqs.q: How do I read a Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrule part number such as M00120-10?
faqs.a: In this series the two digits after the hyphen are the hose dash size, so M00120-10 is dash -10: DN16, 5/8" bore. The same rule holds on every row, for example M00120-03 is -3 and M00110-32 is -32. The five-digit prefix is Manuli's series reference.

faqs.q: Which hose sizes does the Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrule cover?
faqs.a: The Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 covers DN5 – DN51 (3/16" – 2"), which is dash -3 to -32, in 11 part references from M00120-03 to M00110-32. Match the ferrule to the bore on the hose layline, and the series to the hose construction rather than to the bore alone.

faqs.q: What are the outside diameter and length of the Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrule?
faqs.a: Across the M00110 / M00120 / M00130 series the ferrule outside diameter D runs 17.0 – 70.0 and the length L runs 23.9 – 72.0. For example M00120-03 is D 17.0 mm by L 23.9 mm, and M00110-32 is D 70.0 mm by L 72.0 mm. These are as-supplied dimensions, not crimp dimensions.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrule have?
faqs.a: A ferrule carries no pressure rating of its own: the working pressure of a M00110 / M00120 / M00130 assembly is set by the wire braid hose and the fitting it is crimped to, at that bore. The sheet for this series publishes outside diameter and length only. Quote the hose grade and size and we will give the assembly's rating from the hose maker's figure.

faqs.q: What are Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrules made of and what fluids can they see?
faqs.a: The sheet for the M00110 / M00120 / M00130 series does not publish a material or fluid list for the ferrule, so we do not state one. Media and temperature limits are set by the hose tube and cover. No standard or certificate is stated for the ferrule either; an assembly is documented as a whole, so name the test report you need and we will quote it with the M00110, M00120, M00130 references.

faqs.q: What goes with a Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrule to make a hose assembly?
faqs.a: A M00110 / M00120 / M00130 ferrule is crimped together with a matching hose fitting, stem or insert, on wire braid hoses, using a crimper and the correct dies. Browse the [hydraulic fittings](/c/hydraulic-fittings) and [crimp ferrules](/c/crimp-ferrules) shelves for stems and other ferrule types, or send us the hose and end connection.

faqs.q: How do I crimp a Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 skive ferrule correctly?

For hose routing and bend-radius limits in service, read [hose routing, bend radius and twist](/blog/hose-routing-bend-radius-twist).

faqs.q: Manuli M03400 or M03500 ferrule: which should I choose?

faqs.q: How do I read a Manuli M03500 ferrule part number such as M03500-12?
faqs.a: In this series the two digits after the hyphen are the hose dash size, so M03500-12 is dash -12: DN19, 3/4" bore. The same rule holds on every row, for example M03500-06 is -6 and M03500-20 is -20. The five-digit prefix is Manuli's series reference.

faqs.q: Which hose sizes does the Manuli M03500 ferrule cover?

faqs.q: What are the outside diameter and length of the Manuli M03500 ferrule?

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Manuli M03500 ferrule have?
